chunks: They said, 'Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what is its color.' He said, 'Indeed, He says it is a cow, yellow in color, bright to the beholders.'
ai.seo_question: What was the specific color of the cow commanded in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the gradual clarification of the command, where the Israelites' insistence on specifics leads to the description of a 'bright yellow' cow that pleases the beholders, distinguishing it from old or young cattle. In Shia exegesis, this stage emphasizes the transition from general command to precise identification, reflecting the community's tendency to seek detailed legal parameters. The description serves as a test of obedience, ensuring the selected cow was neither used for plowing nor irrigation, thereby preserving its ritual purity.
